name: Sidebar

sources.title: Submit a Link — requires log in or sign up first
About + Submission Guidelines — curated 'five best design links, every weekday'; maintained by Fabricio Teixeira since 2012

requirements: You submit a LINK, not a product listing: articles, portfolios, CodePen demos, case studies
High-effort content only — case studies, tutorials; cookie-cutter listicles and link-through posts discouraged
New content only — links older than a few months won't make the cut
No paid products unless they offer a free/demo tier that's useful standalone; case studies ABOUT paid products are fine
No heavy downloads, app-store links, PDFs; videos rarely featured
Self-promotion is allowed ('posting your own content is fine') if it follows the guidelines
preparation: A genuinely high-effort design-relevant link — ideally a case study or tutorial about/around your product, not the product homepage
Freshness: content published within the last ~2-3 months
workflow: Create an account / log in at sidebar.io/log-in
Editors pick 5 links per weekday — no notification guarantee
Check /archives to see if your link made it
watchFor: A bare product page is unlikely to be featured — wrap it in a valuable story (design process, case study)
Audience is designers/makers — irrelevant links waste the attempt
Paid sponsorship route exists via UX Collective (sponsor link → uxdesigncc Medium post) if editorial doesn't fit
5 slots/day means heavy competition; don't resubmit
countsAsLive: Your link appears on sidebar.io's homepage/archives as one of the day's five curated links
unknowns: Sponsorship pricing (goes through UX Collective/uxdesign.cc contact)
